svg.title: Across the fleet, every fault happens once
svg.desc: A live run. A fix fails on sim-1 and holds on sim-3. A Naïve agent writes the lesson down as a skill in 22 s for $0.03. The gate tries it on sim-2 for 30 s, then promotes it to the fleet: 57 s from the agent session, 0 human clicks.
svg.text: A Naïve agent writes a skill

text.tspan: from the agent session to the whole fleet
